title: Design System: Ctrl Z — Editorial Homepage

display.purpose: Ctrl Z opening title; mobile uses clamp(4rem, 16vw, 5rem).

components.name: Primary Entry Action
components.description: The clear, restrained action used to enter the live simulation.
components.css: .ds-enter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.65; background: var(--page-accent); color: var(--page-ground); cursor: pointer; } .ds-enter:hover { background: var(--page-ink); } .ds-enter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Editorial Navigation
components.description: Quiet sentence-case links with an underlined cyan entry link.
components.html: The ideaPreviewEnter Simulation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; align-items: center; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--page-ink); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--page-accent); } .ds-nav .ds-entry-link { color: var(--page-accent); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-nav { gap: 16px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-nav > a:first-child { display: none; } }

components.name: Gameplay Preview Switch
components.description: A two-option group showing the selected actual gameplay state.
components.css: .ds-preview-switch { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: var(--page-raised); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-preview-switch button { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--page-muted); border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preview-switch button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--page-ground); background: var(--page-accent); } .ds-preview-switch button:hover { color: var(--page-ink); } .ds-preview-switch button[aria-pressed='true']:hover { color: var(--page-ground); } .ds-preview-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-preview-switch { width: 100%; } .ds-preview-switch button { flex: 1; } }

components.css: .ds-features { margin: 0; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--page-ink); } .ds-features > div { padding-block: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--page-edge); } .ds-features > div:first-child { padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; } .ds-features dt { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-features dd { margin: 0; color: var(--page-muted); max-width: 52ch; text-wrap: pretty; }

components.css: .ds-closing { background: var(--page-raised); color: var(--page-ink); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-closing-inner { width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 112px)); margin-inline: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 64px; padding-block: 72px; } .ds-closing h2 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.3vw, 2.75rem); line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-closing p { margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--page-muted); } .ds-closing-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; background: var(--page-accent); color: var(--page-ground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-closing-action:hover { background: var(--page-ink); } .ds-closing-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--page-accent); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-closing-inner { width: calc(100% - 64px); gap: 32px; } } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-closing-inner { width: calc(100% - 40px); grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-block: 48px; gap: 28px; } }

narrative.overview:
Strong typography and clean hierarchy introduce the playable city through a dark reading surface, generous spacing and restrained neon accents. Open text blocks and actual game previews carry the presentation. The mood is calm, direct and precise; the controls feel clear and restrained.

This system applies only to the homepage implemented in `src/Landing.tsx` and `src/landing.css`, loaded by `src/landing-main.tsx` through `index.html`. The embedded and full-screen game at `simulation.html` is a separate, approved system. Its `src/console.css` and `src/style.css`, HUD, controls, service identities, city artwork, renderer, camera, simulation and saves remain protected. These landing tokens must not replace incumbent game tokens. The city retains the Antahonist Neon City direction, secondary `design/pixel-city-reference-2.png` inspiration and commit-27 lineage; rejected commit-28/29 designs remain excluded.
keyCharacteristics: Generous spacing and open text blocks.
Dark overall theme with restrained neon accents.
Actual gameplay imagery with clear preview captions.
An isolated, on-demand playable game below the introduction.

rules.name: The Restrained Neon Rule
rules.body: Use window cyan for entry, selection and focus; let the actual city previews carry the richer game palette.

rules.name: The Clean Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish emphasis with size, weight and space; preserve readable text rather than adding tracked eyebrows or ornamental labels.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep editorial surfaces flat; reserve tonal layering for the preview switch and closing invitation.

dos: **Do** use strong typography, clean hierarchy and generous spacing.
**Do** use window cyan for entry, selection and focus.
**Do** use actual game previews with readable captions and accurate alternative text.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, touch target sizes and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep homepage styles isolated from the approved game system.
donts: **Don't** introduce generic SaaS cards, glass, decorative glow or ornamental cyberpunk clutter into the homepage.
**Don't** invent metrics, testimonials, awards or unimplemented gameplay scenarios.
**Don't** replace the protected game UI, city artwork or game tokens with this landing system.
**Don't** add tracked eyebrows, section numbers or decorative icon grids to establish hierarchy.
